entry.title: New: review-workflow
entry.summary: A structured multi-panelist review workflow for the DeepSeek Harness: N panelists score in isolated subagents, blind to each other; a chair reconciles disagreement by anchor match then Δ-level adjudication; an independent critic audits the process. Works for design, code, paper or project review. Exact install spec: github:lesliewylie/review-workflow. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
